description:
Delete every table that restates an extern declaration. Proposal at ../extern-proposal.html (2026-09-13). Steps, in order: 1 debris sweep; 2 export the compiler binary and test symbols dynamically (measured: with -rdynamic or -export_dynamic every rlib no_mangle export survives and dlsym finds it; delete JIT registry + interp address book); 3 comparison inlining keyed on resolved Kernel clause identity; 4 delete the manifest (syn conformance test + fz_ symbol namespace reserved to bootstrap); 5 one wire alphabet mapping; 6 import table without *Refs ceremony; 7 one variadic dispatcher table, native variadic via imported symbol; 9 docs + migration-proof test collapse. Supersedes fz-5xp.32.

Step 8 (one arithmetic denotation for guards) was never part of the fz-5xp.30 contract, which deliberately defers arithmetic substitution and keeps comparison replacement separate; it grew into its own epic, fz-tqd (guards are code), stacked on PR #158. What remains here closes PR #158: fz-21x.10, fz-21x.2, fz-21x.14.

The arithmetic allocation this branch made loud (one struct per '+') is an older defect in entry dispatch, fz-21x.25, fixed against main in its own session and merged forward; PR #158 does not wait on it.
title: [EPIC] Extern door collapse: the declaration is the definition
